remote.description: Remote execution configuration (for API proxy mode)

ModelApiSurface.description:
Which HTTP API surface a model speaks.

Providers historically expose the OpenAI-compatible `chat/completions` shape. Newer OpenAI-family models are only reachable through the Responses API (`/responses`), which uses a different request and event schema. A Bit declares the surface so the client builds the matching Rig client and the Flow-Like proxy relays to the matching upstream endpoint.

api_surface.description: API surface the upstream model speaks. `None` keeps the provider's historical default, which is `chat/completions` for every hosted Bit.

RemoteExecutionConfig.description: Configuration for remote execution via API proxy

endpoint.description:
Deprecated per-bit endpoint URL. Remote embeddings now use the shared
INTERNAL_EMBEDDING_ENDPOINT secret resolved by the API.

secret_name.description: Optional API key secret override. Defaults to INTERNAL_EMBEDDING_SECRET.

implementation.description: Which remote provider implementation to use

model_id.description: Deployed model ID for the upstream provider (e.g., Internal gateway model name)

oneOf.description:
Internal OpenAI-compatible embedding gateway.

Older bit configs serialized as `HuggingfaceEndpoint` or
`CloudflareWorkersAI` are accepted as aliases so existing records can be
migrated by config alone.
